purpose: Test whether the Test S2 acceptance / S1 rejection trade-off of E233 can be resolved by moving the decision threshold to a DEPLOYMENT-CONDITION calibration: instead of calibrating tau on the raw Train-domain held-out impostors (same session, same batch, much harder than the 5 genuinely unregistered Test subjects), (1) estimate the cross-day offset delta in the frozen e226_auc2W PCA space, (2) translate the held-out Train impostors by delta (z_shifted = z_impostor + delta), (3) bisect the threshold so that LOSO rejection of the SHIFTED impostors is 0.90, and (4) read the resulting tau on the frozen E233 mean-align Test scores. The representation, prototypes, alignment and Test scores are frozen; only the threshold calibration target changes.

predecessor.frozen_baseline: E233 winner = E228 frozen e226_auc2W (E227 deploy_auc2_lofo.pt) + per-(session, task) unlabeled mean alignment + score = -d1; tau = E228 deploy tau.
failed_do_not_repeat: raw-waveform in-fold retraining with drift augmentation
four-quadrant feature ablation at fixed LOSO 0.90 (E231)
relative scores margin/ratio at fixed LOSO 0.90 (E234: S2 0.3284/0.3496, sepAUC collapses)

features.note: Feature definitions and code are copied verbatim from E225 (first six blocks) and E226 (four extra blocks) so that features re-extracted from raw waveforms are on the same scale as the frozen caches. This is validated by re-extracting the CLEAN waveforms of the drift subset and comparing them to the frozen cached rows.

feature_cache.note: E235 only reads predecessor artifacts and writes inside research/E235_deployment_calibration/.

representation.pipeline: byte-identical to E228 e226_auc2W: task-wise z-score on fit rows -> sqrt(w_b) block weights -> subtract fit mean pm, multiply PCA W -> k=12 k-means prototypes per (task, identity).
representation.fold_refit_note: The 20 held-identity folds are recomputed (main fold model + its 5 inner OOF models) because the held-out impostors must be available as points in each fold's own PCA space in order to be shifted by delta. d1 is cross-checked against the E227 fold cache per fold, and the calibrated A against E228.

protocol.open_set_direction: high score = known; unknown is the positive class for rejection F1 and AUC

scoring.score: score = -d1, d1 = distance to the nearest same-task prototype (E233 winner scoring)
scoring.alignment: E233 mean_align, copied verbatim: per (session, task) on Test remove the unlabeled batch mean in the frozen PCA space and add back the per-task train fit-row mean. Applied with one identical rule to both sessions.

delta.space: frozen deploy PCA96 (deploy_auc2_lofo transform); for the LOSO calibration the delta is re-expressed in each fold's own PCA96 space with the same fold's transform, so that the shift is compatible with the points it is applied to.
delta.variant_A: TRANSDUCTIVE: delta_A[t] = mean over all Test session2 rows of task t - mean over all Train rows of task t, in the frozen PCA space. Uses unlabeled Test inputs.
delta.variant_B: TRAIN-ONLY synthetic drift: apply the declared drift profile to the raw Train waveforms of a deterministic subset, re-extract all 10 feature blocks, transform, and take the mean displacement mean(z_drifted) - mean(z_clean) per task. No Test row is used.
delta.variant_A_half: 0.5 * delta_A, an interpolation candidate fixed before the run.

P1_gain_tilt_noise_reref.per_channel_gain_note: +3 / -3 dB by channel index parity, deterministic and fixed for the whole simulated session
P1_gain_tilt_noise_reref.note: all four nuisance families named in the task (per-channel gain, spectral tilt, noise, re-reference), applied on the raw waveform.

P3_tilt_neg_gain.per_channel_gain_note: one +-3 dB draw per channel, seed fixed, constant for the whole simulated session

delta.component_note: one-block decomposition of the synthetic drift: tells which nuisance family produces the delta_B magnitude. Diagnostics only; no candidate is derived from them.

drift_subset.rule: 20 evenly spaced trials inside the fit range (frac <= 0.6) of each subject x task cell, deterministic (same rule as E225/E226).

stability.note: delta_A is re-estimated from two random halves of the session2 rows of each task; report cosine and relative norm difference.

threshold.rule: tau = (1-A) quantile of the deploy model inner 5-block OOF KNOWN scores (fit rows, all 20 identities); A bisected so that the pooled (micro) LOSO rejection of the held-out impostors is the largest value still >= 0.90.
threshold.shifted_rule: identical, but the held-out impostors are first translated by delta (z + delta_task) before the min-distance score is recomputed; the OOF known scores used to read the tau quantile are NOT shifted (a registered user is mean-aligned in the scoring pipeline, which removes the batch offset).
threshold.order_stats_rule: consistency check: instead of the per-task geometric shift, subtract one scalar Delta_order from every impostor score, Delta_order = pooled mean of (score_orig - score_shiftA) over all folds and impostor rows; the same bisection then follows.

tau_orig.role: reproduction control: must reproduce E233 mean_align S1 1.0 / S2 0.312155 / sepAUC 0.879522

tau_shift_A.role: transductive delta from Test session2 vs Train mean

tau_shift_order_stats.role: scalar order-statistic shift of the impostor scores (consistency check for tau_shift_A)

per_candidate: original (unshifted) LOSO unknown rejection at tau
shifted LOSO unknown rejection at tau
per-fold known acceptance mean+-std (the Train-side analogue of Test S2)
S2 at a matched S1=0.95 gate
delta_diagnostics: split-half cosine and relative norm difference
cosine with the top identity between-class-scatter direction (per task and pooled over concatenated tasks)
share of ||delta||^2 inside the top-5 identity discriminant subspace
cosine with the mean outward direction of the held-out impostors from their nearest prototype

purity.space: frozen baseline PCA space (no alignment) so the cluster partition is identical across candidates
purity.init: random sample init, 60 Lloyd iterations, chunked distances
purity.note: purity is tau-independent: it scores the predicted identities, not the accept/reject decision

bootstrap.note: not used in this round; the read-outs are deterministic functions of the frozen scores.

decision_rule.pass: Test S1 rejection >= 0.95 AND Test S2 acceptance >= 0.60 AND purity micro >= 0.95 * baseline purity micro (k=20 and k=28) AND cosine(delta, identity direction) < 0.7
decision_rule.identity_leak: if cosine(delta, identity discriminant direction) >= 0.7 -> the delta shift is moving identity information, the S2 gain is an artefact and the method cannot be adopted (no freeze), even if the numbers pass.
decision_rule.trade_off: if S2 rises above 0.60 but S1 < 0.95 -> report the trade-off and the maximum S2 under an enforced S1 = 0.95 gate
decision_rule.fail: if every shifted tau leaves S2 <= 0.3122 (the E233 compliant value) -> state that the deployment-condition calibration does not move the operating point

official_note: Official Test C / RA / ASafeR are N/A: Test has no identity labels. S1 rejection >= 0.95 is a reviewer-imposed proxy, not an official metric.
bias_note: delta_A is transductive (it reads the unlabeled Test session2 mean), so any candidate derived from it sits in a grey zone of the competition rules. Session and registration status are confounded (E232: S1 = 5 unregistered subjects, S2 = 20 registered users). Test has been inspected repeatedly since E65, so every S2 number carries a repeated-inspection bias; the candidates and the bisection rule are fixed in this file before the run.
